source.title: EU supplier/shipping-origin data source for BOM (free, maintained)
source.body:
Useful project — quantity mapping is exactly the hard part of PrintNC builds.

One data gap for EU users: the same part list has very different landed cost depending on shipping origin. US-direct orders end up +40–50% after customs/VAT handling, while the same parts from EU warehouses (PL/DE/CZ/ES) arrive in 3–10 days with zero customs. There are also a few recurring part-spec traps (1605 vs 1610 ballscrew ends, anti-backlash nut handedness, rail length vs travel) that a generator could validate.

I maintain a free, per-build BOM→EU-supplier mapping here (quantities, supplier paths, ordering traps):
https://gist.github.com/estovisioncontact-bit/d80d74146b9ea5b9ebd7586559b130a2

If it's useful, it could serve as an "EU shipping origin" hint layer in the generator, or I can format it as JSON/CSV keyed to the same part IDs. Compiled while sourcing my own build.

comments.author: estovisioncontact-bit
comments.text:
EU supplier data contribution (optional): I mapped PrintNC/LowRider/MPCNC BOM quantities to EU-warehouse suppliers (zero customs, 3–10 days) + 6 ordering traps + 48h ordering plan. If useful as a data source for the generator, free guide here: https://estovisioncontact-bit.github.io/cnc-sourcing-pl-eu/

Question for maintainers: would you accept a PR adding an 'EU suppliers' tab / region filter to the generator? Happy to format as CSV/JSON if preferred.

comments.author: interias
comments.text: Hey, feel free to create a PR. I will Check, Feedback and merge IT.
